About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

Summary:

We are seeking a skilled Cloud Engineer with a focus on Cloud Governance to join our team. This role is critical in ensuring that our cloud infrastructure is managed effectively, securely, and in compliance with industry standards and company policies.

What You'll Do:

· Develop, implement, monitor, and enforce cloud governance frameworks and policies to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices; We automate everything for efficiency

· Ensure cloud infrastructure adheres to security best practices and compliance

standards

· Conduct regular security assessments and audits

· Implement and manage identity and access management (IAM) policies

· Manage and implement hardware security keys (e.g., YubiKeys)

· Monitor cloud usage, costs, and implement strategies to optimize spending

· Provide regular reports and insights on cloud costs and usage trends to senior leadership and Finance

· Develop automated, seamless, and simple solutions to minimize repetitive manual operations

· Work closely with development and security teams to minimize restrictions that inhibit progress as well as ensuring cloud governance policies are integrated into workflows

· Provide communication, training, and guidance to development teams on new policies, procedures, and best practices for cloud resource management

· Develop CI/CD pipelines for deploying policies and other CSP management

· Respond to and resolve cloud governance-related incidents and issues; Provide

root cause analysis when necessary

What You'll Bring:

· Strong understanding of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud

· Deep understanding and proven ability to effectively manage an Enterprise-scale Entra environment

· Implementation of Zero Trust security strategies and proven ability to protect identities, endpoints, data, applications, and infrastructure

· Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates, and/or CloudFormation Templates (CFT)

· Experience with large scale CSP (Cloud Service Provider) account and vendor relationship management

· Proven ability to align cloud environments with compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC2, FedRAMP, NIST)

· Expert in Identity and Access Management (IAM)

· Strong understanding and experience with SAML and OIDC for authentication

· Strong understanding and experience with JIT (Just-In-Time) privilege elevation

· Experience with cloud cost management tools and strategies and ability to analyze and report on cloud cost data

· Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical stakeholders

· Strong teamwork and collaboration skills

· Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills

· Ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize effectively

· Relevant cloud certifications (e.g. Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect)

· Previous experience in a similar role focusing on cloud governance

For this Job, Delinea is not considering candidates that need any type of US work authorization now or in the future. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, L-1, J1, etc.

Why work at Delinea?

  • We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

  • We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

  • What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:

  • Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do

  • Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

  • Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

  • Ownership - We take initiative and follow through

  • Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment

  • Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.

Delinea is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Upon conditional offer of employment, candidates are required to complete comprehensive criminal background check, verification of education, and verification of employment, per employment policy. In addition, all publicly posted social media sites may be reviewed.
